admission.justification: Four places realize one path — admission, load, confined server, native launch — and the mistake it prevents is authoring on a read, publishing on an unloaded revision, or writing outside the attempt folder.

applicability: Every explainer seat started for one leaf, and the environment the leaf's first request builds.
conditions: The environment lives under <coordination>/explainer/<repository>/<task>/<leaf>, one per leaf.
Every writer of the environment's durable facts takes the leaf's one lock and admits its target first.
A publication follows one model-free load and a readiness report over the staged bytes.
exclusions: The retired canvas presenter POSTs, which are refused by name canvas-authoring-replaced.
The architect's explainer_control tool, which updates or retires a seat instead of authoring a page.
statement: An explainer authors only inside one environment per leaf, kept outside every worktree, memory repository and task folder; every path it writes is admitted by a guard that holds a link or an escape instead of following it; and it publishes only through the frame store, after one model-free load of the prospective revision and a readiness check over that revision's exact bytes.
